name: What's the difference between a bathroom refresh and a full bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a bathroom refresh and a full bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom refresh focuses on cosmetic and functional updates, typically without changing the layout or major plumbing/electrical systems. This includes painting, replacing fixtures, flooring, and vanities. A full bathroom remodel, conversely, often involves reconfiguring the layout, moving plumbing lines, replacing the bathtub or shower enclosure entirely, and can be a more extensive and costly project. A refresh is ideal for improving aesthetics and functionality efficiently, especially for foreclosed properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: A refresh updates cosmetics and fixtures without changing layout; a full remodel reconfigures layout and involves major plumbing/electrical changes.
